focusedRunLimitValidation.note: The preceding combined8-Sprite matrix at bccea4cc reported a 30s case timeout and a fixture workerd exit; both source files passed separately with CONTRACT_CONCURRENCY=1. Final matrix reruns these cases.

focusedProtocolClose.note: The Worker sends an existing closed control frame before closing the expired browser stream; the adapter delivers that frame and EOF without waiting for the host TCP close. Node SSE behavior is unchanged.

publicContractAttempts.note: Isolated branch included a speculative dedicated expiry job, which did not fix closure and was not merged. The run-limit and model-stall files subsequently passed sequential focused runs.

hibernationCloseProbe.description: The same Node built-in WebSocket client; each endpoint sends close1008 after1000ms.
hibernationCloseProbe.resolution: Use the existing closed protocol control frame to finish the client reader and initiate local closure. Do not keep a Worker or Durable Object awake.
